translationRepairs: Fu Shuyan's son Jinghe, Regional Inspector of Liangzhou, felt shame at heart; in Luoyang he extensively engaged in bribery, seeking the mobile office position.

崔聖念 romanizes as Cui Shengnian (聖念); idiomatic Shengian drops the n of 念 and is a clear transliteration error.
〈後廢帝〉 is Later/Latter Deposed Emperor; Former would require 前廢帝, so the idiomatic Former mistranslates 後.
Literal likewise renders 後廢帝 as Former; Later Deposed Emperor matches 後 rather than 前.
